g.aria-label: The Cost of Overwriting: Collateral Signal Erosion Across m Writes
Each subsequent random unit key k_s (β=1) multiplies stored pair (k_i, v_i) by (I − k_s k_sᵀ)
Expected signal after m writes: E[S_t k_i] = (1 − 1/d_k)^m v_i ≈ exp(−m / d_k) v_i
Delta rule excels at rebinding ≤ d_k keys; additive sums erode slower when m > d_k
